# Astranex Defence

> Astranex Defence develops autonomous robotic platforms and edge-AI security systems engineered for mission-critical land, air, and maritime operations.

## Main Pages

- [Homepage](https://astranexdefence.com/): Autonomous systems overview, mission, vision, engineering team, and contact inquiry.
- [Careers Portal](https://astranexdefence.com/careers.html): Career opportunities, open engineering domains, and application form.
- [Security Policy](https://astranexdefence.com/.well-known/security.txt): Vulnerability disclosure guidelines and official security contacts.

## Optional

- [Robotics & Autonomous Systems](https://astranexdefence.com/#mission): Modular mechatronics and autonomous robotic platform architecture.
- [Edge-AI Security Platform](https://astranexdefence.com/#vision): Computer vision and situational edge intelligence for sovereign defense.
